caption: The drawing features a single object: a traditional rocking horse centered on a plain, light-colored background. The horse is depicted in profile facing left, with a primarily gray body that has subtle spots suggesting wood grain or surface texture. Its mane and tail are a darker shade of gray, almost black. The horse has a brown bridle and a reddish-brown saddle with two stirrups hanging down. The rocking base is made up of two curved blue runners connected by two planks, also painted blue, beneath the horse. The lines and details are finely rendered, and there are no additional objects, patterns, or scenery in the drawing. The artist's signature, "Alex Hirsch," is in the lower right corner in small blue letters.
title: Rocking Horse
